name: 78660 · Pflugerville, TX
findings: ZIP 78660 (Pflugerville) has 230 nonprofit organizations. 90 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 68 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78660 (Pflugerville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 17 hobby and sports organizations here list public events, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 28 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
